recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat olive oil and fry the pancetta until crispy.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Whisk eggs, Pecorino, Parmesan, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Drain the pasta, reserving a bit of cooking water.
Combine the pasta with pancetta and garlic, remove from heat.
Quickly stir in the egg and cheese mixture, adding pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and black pepper.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add broccoli, red pepper, and carrot, and stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil, stir well to coat the vegetables.
Continue stir-frying for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then sprinkle sesame seeds on top.
Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cream together butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla, beating until well combined.
In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture, mixing well.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Scoop dough onto baking sheets, spacing about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
